fit.clearance_definition: TOTAL slot width minus measured stock thickness

side_channel.rule: Measure the real profile first. Do not generate channel slots from catalog guesses. Reject any slot narrower than the confirmed cutter.
side_channel.physical_test: After cutting, insert the real channel and a real 5 mm glass sample. Select the shallowest/least-wide slot that retains the profile without visibly compressing the glass channel.

release_rule: Both 18 mm and 12 mm production lots must be measured and coupon-qualified before full-sheet release. Side-channel slot must additionally pass with the real 03-7135-1-class profile and 5 mm glass sample.
